note: First my-uob cards recipe, written 20 Nov 2026 from the plain all-cards.page. The listing reports data-total=15 and data-max=6, so only six tiles are in the server-rendered HTML. The Load more control posts to /revamp/personal/ajax-category-page-filter.page, and robots.txt Disallow: /revamp/* blocks that path, so this recipe stays in plain mode and does not use actions.expand_selector. Query filters such as all-cards.page?filter=cashback render the same unfiltered first six tiles. Some More details links include i_cid=, which robots.txt Disallow: /*i_cid=* blocks; this recipe has no detail block so those query strings are not fetched. Clean product URLs (query stripped) and sitemap product URLs, plus names in the terms table on all-cards.page, are read by hand.
